target: bench.sh reconcile — creates a freshness-merged worktree for a pr-open spec
cmd: source "$FIXTURES/bench-repo.sh"; bench_fixture_setup; cd work; export FACTORY_BENCH_DIR="$PWD/../benches"; mkdir -p .agentic; echo '{"bench":{"enabled":true}}' > .agentic/config.json; bench_fixture_spec . pr-open feature 001; source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/bench.sh"; bench_reconcile; jq -n --arg has_main "$([ -f "$FACTORY_BENCH_DIR/feature/f.txt" ] && echo yes || echo no)" --arg has_feature "$([ -f "$FACTORY_BENCH_DIR/feature/f2.txt" ] && echo yes || echo no)" --arg branch "$(git -C "$FACTORY_BENCH_DIR/feature" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null)" '{has_main: $has_main, has_feature: $has_feature, branch: $branch}'
